output.title: Renovated 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
This sophisticated penthouse offers approximately 220 m² of renovated living space situated in Belair, an upscale and green residential neighborhood of Luxembourg. The bright and airy living room features floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light and frame panoramic views of the city. Oak parquet flooring and a wood-burning fireplace provide refined accents that enhance the contemporary open-plan layout, while integrated smart-home lighting adds modern convenience.

The sleek kitchen is equipped with professional-grade Gaggenau appliances and includes a Carrara marble island perfect for entertaining. Matte black fixtures and a built-in wine fridge complete the minimalist design, creating an efficient and stylish culinary space.

Accommodations include four bedrooms and three bathrooms. The master suite offers a walk-in closet, an ensuite bathroom, and access to a private terrace, extending the living area outdoors. The expansive main terrace spans south-facing exposure with composite decking, a glass balustrade, and an outdoor lounge area, providing unobstructed 180-degree views over Luxembourg City.

Additional amenities include elevator access, a cellar for storage, and parking facilities. This property combines modern finishes and expansive outdoor space within a distinguished residential district known for its quiet streets and proximity to urban amenities.

highlights.text: Open-plan living room with wood-burning fireplace
Kitchen with Gaggenau appliances and marble island
South-facing terrace with panoramic city views
